## Natural history notes

A medium-sized wolf spider characterized by its sandy gray to brown coloration, dark markings on the legs and body, and strong camouflage against open sand. In Florida, it is found mainly along sandy shorelines, beaches, dunes, coastal scrub, and other sparsely vegetated sandy areas. Unlike orb-weavers, it does not build a prey-capturing web; instead, it hunts actively on the ground, feeding on small insects and other arthropods, and often shelters in shallow sand burrows or concealed spots during the day.
